name: Large light-water reactors
applications: industrial heat and hydrogen (in design studies)
principle: Pressurised and boiling water reactors above 300 MWe use water as coolant and moderator to raise steam for turbines. The World Nuclear Association lists 316 operable PWRs (306.2 GWe) and 60 BWRs (61.0 GWe), with licence extensions to 60 years and sometimes 80 years.

source.note: World Nuclear Association, Nuclear power reactors, updated 5 August 2026
World Nuclear Association, Nuclear power reactors, updated 5 August 2026
IEA ETP Clean Energy Technology Guide, dataset of 24 July 2026, latest assessment (IEA 1-11 scale): 'Generation III/III+ large reactors' 9 (2025)

limitations: High capital cost and long build times (not quantified in the source read)

sources.note: World Nuclear Association, Nuclear power reactors, updated 5 August 2026
Gulf Business, UAE nuclear project raises $24.4bn, 23 Oct 2016

gaps.item: process steps and equipment are general engineering practice, not taken from one source
gaps.reason: The sources read describe the principle but not a full step-by-step flow.

where.hint: Open process-description authority (secondary): Wikipedia article 'Light-water reactor'. Cross-check the card's process_steps against it, then cite it in sources with note 'secondary'.

reference_plants.name: Barakah Nuclear Energy Plant, UAE (ENEC/NAWAH)
reference_plants.capacity: four APR1400 units, 5.6 GW total, about 25% of UAE electricity; construction from 2012; Unit 4 grid-connected March 2024; ~40 TWh/yr

source.note: World Nuclear News, 5 Sep 2024 (5,600 MW total, ~25% of UAE electricity); energyconnects 25 Mar 2024 (Unit 4 grid connection); read 2026-10-28

costs.metric: Barakah four-unit plant cost (financing basis) and build time
costs.unit: USD/kW derived (USD 24.4 bn for 5.6 GW); build time 12 years (2012-2024)
costs.basis: derived: "The UAE's nuclear energy project has completed a $24.4bn [financing]... four 1,400 megawatt nuclear reactors" (Gulf Business, Oct 2016); 24.4e9 / 5.6e6 = 4,357 USD/kW. Financing-basis figure, not a settled overnight cost; construction ran 2012 to Unit-4 grid connection in March 2024
